text: The gluteus maximus is the main muscle that extends the hip.
The gluteus medius moves the thigh out to the side (hip abduction).
The iliopsoas lifts the thigh forward (hip flexion).
The erector spinae straightens the spine and also bends and rotates it.
Side-bridge variations switch on the gluteus medius strongly (over about two-thirds of its maximum) in healthy adults.

review.notes: Single small lab study; no pain or injury outcome. Grade C because it is not a review or trial.
